notes.title: Thank you!!!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello hoomans!

We're purring out loud with all the love you've shown for [b]A Building Full of Cats 2[/b]! 

We’ve been reading your messages and wanted to share a few updates and improvements we’re working on:[/p][list][*][p]We’re making some instructions clearer in the game on how to proceed with some of the minigames and parts of the game that seem to be confusing some players.[/p][/*][*][p]We’re adding an option to skip the rhythm minigames for those who prefer a more relaxed experience.[/p][/*][*][p]A Building Full of Cats 2 is now verified for [b]Steam Deck[/b]![/p][/*][*][p]While the game is working well for most players, a few bugs are still affecting some. We’re doing our best to fix them as quickly as possible — thank you for your patience. ːcrycat2ː[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve added cloud save support and are working on an automatic save backup to keep your progress extra safe.[/p][/*][*][p]And best of all: [b]Steam Trading Cards[/b] are ready and currently waiting for approval from Steam.[/p][/*][/list][p] 
More updates are on the way!  [/p][p]
Thanks again for being part of this cat-filled journey with us, especially in this devastating moment for us… You can’t imagine how meaningful your supportive messages have been. ːfofinoː
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45019236/50626d71bc7a7a02e212ec841da7fe0175f7b539.jpg"][/img][i]Fofiño Forever[/i]

Love and purrs, 
The Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ[/p]

notes.title: A Building Full of Cats 2 is finally here!
notes.notes:
[p]It’s here! [b]A BUILDING FULL OF CATS 2[/b] is now available! ːcathspawː

It all started with [b]A Building Full of Cats[/b]—our very first [b]Full of Cats[/b] game. From those early days to now, we've come a long way. With each new title, we’ve tried to add a little more oohmpf, a little more heart, and a little more magic than the last.

It’s been such a sweet journey—but also a challenging one. Since 2022, we’ve barely paused for a breath. There were days we felt exhausted, wondering how we’d keep going… but every time we see how much you enjoy our games—and especially the message behind them—it makes it all worth it.

Because love brings love. And we’re not ready to stop. ːfofino2ːSo today, we proudly present you [b]A BUILDING FULL OF CATS 2[/b]. We hope you take your time to enjoy it!

This is a different animal (still a feline, though) from the first game. Expect a much longer playtime and a far more diverse experience overall.

We truly hope it brings you joy. ːwinkycatː

And if you think this one is big… well, just wait.
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3355100/A_Planet_Full_of_Cats/"][/dynamiclink][b]A PLANET FULL OF CATS[/b] is already on the horizon. Wishlist it now and get ready for the next step in our adventures.

As always, thank you for your continued support.[/p][p]In this very moment, all your support has been what gives us the strength to go on. ːfofinoː

Love and Purrs,
The Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Meet Danton
notes.notes:
[p]Ladies and Gentleman! 

What you’ll experience tomorrow is no mere trick. This building... is enchanted.
Its magic is the love each and every resident feel for their cats. 

Make sure not to miss it! 

See you on the other side of the curtain.
Danton[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45019236/9be6b751659c71af61a301fcb3745abb693093fc.png"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2810730/A_Building_Full_of_Cats_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Meet Henrik
notes.notes: [p]Hail,[/p][p]Dark clouds of thunder are approaching fast,[/p][p]I hear the roaring of the beasts growing louder,[/p][p]Be sure to be here as the dawn breaks,[/p][p]The chase begins when the final chord fades.[/p][p]Henrik[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45019236/a656c1bd2ddd04b4ba47053c9d86e42d82593758.png"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2810730/A_Building_Full_of_Cats_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Meet Olive
notes.notes:
[p]Hi there,

I got so caught up reading the new volume of my favorite manga that I almost missed my trip!

While I was distracted, the cats took over my room—and now they’re hiding among all my books, plushies, and shelves.

I’d really appreciate your help getting everything back in order!
Olive[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45019236/3415fe2d219a73b2ed6607feb7e755d3bc10338f.png"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2810730/A_Building_Full_of_Cats_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Meet Grace
notes.notes:
[p]Hello,

I'm working on some last-minute touches to my art pieces before heading off on a trip, but I might’ve made a bigger mess than expected!

The cats saw the chaos and turned it into their personal playground.

Now I’m counting on your help—after all, searching is part of the art!
Grace[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45019236/a4425ea642efec238379384ef90716f366e00a22.png"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2810730/A_Building_Full_of_Cats_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Meet Gareth
notes.notes:
[p]Peace to All,

While I meditate, I ask that you practice mindfulness by seeking the hidden cats of our sanctuary. 

The journey is inward… but also behind the bookshelf.  

Observe. 
Breathe. 
Discover.  

Gareth[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45019236/04889c913d06bf6e089a8d83d224846205ae06e2.png"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2810730/A_Building_Full_of_Cats_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Meet Tracy
notes.notes:
[p]Hey!

I was setting up for a stream when the cats went full zoomies mode! 
Now I’m heading out, and they’ve completely taken over my setup like it’s theirs.

If you’re up for it, I could really use your help getting things back in order.
And watch your step—stepping on a keycap really hurts!

Thanks a ton! 
Tracy[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45019236/795a9ec0f6cd69dcd2f7ee99a9e01c50382763cf.png"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2810730/A_Building_Full_of_Cats_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Meet Walter
notes.notes:
[p]Dear music lover,

I was composing a masterpiece, but now all my notes are... pawsed. These cats turned my studio into a messy jam! I hope you’ve got an ear for more than just music—some of them hide in harmony.

Help me get them back in tune.

Walter[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45019236/97a0fe3ac128a16bef6628895adb811a824ec77f.png"][/img][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2810730/A_Building_Full_of_Cats_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Meet Axel
notes.notes:
[p]Yo! Wassup!? 

I left for leg day and came back to pet my cats—my post-training routine wouldn’t be the same without them. Total CATtastrophe if they’re missing!  

I need you to step up, flex your observation muscles, and have some fun.  

These cats are agile—but so are you. 
Axel   [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45019236/2c157ce9ac8202d3ebf3bde6bc3e135e5b8d585e.png"][/img][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2810730/A_Building_Full_of_Cats_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Meet Jerome
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, player-one! 

Can’t wait to show you my game collection! I’m just missing a few cartridges to complete my Super Mewtendo set. Some of them are pretty hard to find, though.  

But now the real challenge has begun: the cats found their way in.  They’ve hidden behind consoles, inside game boxes. One even reset my save file.  

Grab your joystick. See you soon!
Jerome[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45019236/1d1cd6212359c382243db1b80f30ae35710db0d4.png"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2810730/A_Building_Full_of_Cats_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Meet Sophie
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, stranger.

I hope you've packed your crystals and salt. This building hides more than just cats... There are whispers in the walls, and spectral meows among them. I’ll be gone cleansing some dark corners of this city, but I need you to uncover what my cats may have—accidentally—unleashed.

Be vigilant. They'll be waiting for you.

Sophie[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45019236/c9fa34760dda9879861a47795fe042f76418f22f.png"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2810730/A_Building_Full_of_Cats_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello hoomans!

The cats are ready, the building is nearly complete, and the wait is almost over!
We’re thrilled to announce that [b]A Building Full of Cats 2[/b] launches on [b]June 16th[/b].

It’s been quite the journey since our very first [b]Full of Cats[/b] game, and now—finally—our first full-fledged sequel is here. 
This sequel is so much more than an expansion with more floors. A LOT OF SURPURRISES awaits for you! ːwinkycatː
We can’t wait to hear what you think about it. ːfofinoː

Stay tuned, and don’t forget to wishlist it now: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2810730/A_Building_Full_of_Cats_2/

Thank you so much for these 3 years of love that made these series pawssible!
We wouldn't make it without your support! ːfofino2ː

Love and Purrs,
The Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

notes.title: Play the demo now!
notes.notes:
Hello hoomans! ːcathspawː

The demo is finally here! Now you get to meet Tracy, the building’s first resident, and help take care of the cats while she’s away.

Check out her letter and get ready to explore! We’re beyond excited to hear what you think of our very first sequel!

[b][i]"Hi! My name’s Tracy, and I’m the first (and so far, only) resident of this brand-new building. It’s pretty quiet around here—well, except for the cats. They’ve kinda taken over the place, but I don’t mind. Between gaming sessions, they keep me great company.

I’ll be away for a few days, and I need someone I can trust to look after them. That’s where you come in! Make sure they’re happy, keep them out of trouble (good luck with that), and maybe you’ll even find a few surprises along the way.

Thanks for helping out! I owe you one.
Tracy"[/i][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/WPiEfWq.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3534260/A_Building_Full_of_Cats_2_Demo/

We hope you enjoy it, and as always, thank you for your incredible support! ːfofino2ː
When we started this journey, we never imagined we’d find such a loving community—or that we’d have the chance to create a sequel! This is all thanks to you. ːfofinoː

Love and purrs,
The Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

notes.title: A Building Full of Cats 2 Demo is coming!
notes.notes:
Hello hoomans!

A long time ago, in a cozy little building, you found me... and that changed everything! ːfofinoː

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vNnL5Hz.png[/img]

Since then, I've traveled through different worlds and lived countless adventures. But now, it's time to return—because my help is needed once again!

This time, the building is much bigger, the cats are even more mischievous, and the surprises? Well, you'll just have to see for yourself! ːwinkycatː

The demo for [b]A Building Full of Cats 2[/b] is coming next week! 

Stay tuned, keep your paws sharp, and prepare for the biggest cat search yet!
Who knows what lies in this new building? ːwrycatː

Love and purrs,
Mr. Fofiño & The Devcats

notes.title: A New Building
notes.notes:
Hello, hoomans! ːfofinoː

We have finally delivered the latest update for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2582360/An_Arcade_Full_of_Cats_TimeWarp_Trouble/][b]An Arcade Full of Cats[/b][/url], and it was a lot of work! We are very proud of it and hope you love it as much as we do.

But no time to rest! We are focusing all our efforts on finishing the demo of [b]A Building Full of Cats 2[/b], and we hope you can play it soon! 

Here is the apartment floor plan:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wEJx2sp.png[/img]

Each apartment will now have three rooms and far more cats than the original. And well, this will be the biggest Full of Cats yet! ːlovecatː

Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for all your support! ːwinkycatː

Love and purrs,
The Devcats
